home.title: Your next service slot is closer than you think.
home.subtitle: Book a trusted workshop, track the work, and keep every vehicle record in one place.
home.nextAvailableSubtitle: Workshops with a real slot you can book today.
home.nearbySubtitle: Sorted by distance from your location.
home.popularPartsSubtitle: Pickup-only finds from workshops around you.
home.step1Body: Compare workshops by distance, rating, opening hours and the next available slot.
home.step2Body: Choose your vehicle and services, describe the complaint, and get a clear estimate.
home.step3Body: Follow the service timeline, approve any extra work, then pay online or cash at the counter.
home.ctaBody: Create a garage, save your vehicles, and never lose another service record.
home.reminderBody: Your {vehicle} is due for a check. Book a slot before the queue fills up.

discover.title: Discover workshops

discover.name: Name
discover.locationHint: Use your location or search a city to sort by distance.
discover.locationDenied: Location permission was denied. Showing Jakarta as a starting point.
discover.locationUnavailable: Location is unavailable in this browser. Showing Jakarta as a starting point.
discover.noResultsBody: Try another type, rating, or location.

booking.title: Book a service
booking.subtitle: Choose a vehicle, the work you need, and a slot that fits.
booking.noVehicleBody: Add a {type} to your garage before booking this workshop.
booking.servicesHint: Tick everything you want checked or replaced. Every item has its own price, so the total updates as you choose.
booking.inspectionNote: Not sure what is broken? Choose the free inspection. The workshop diagnoses the vehicle first and sends a quote before any paid work, so the final total can be higher than the estimate.
booking.noSlotsBody: Try another date. Requested bookings do not hold a slot until the workshop confirms.
booking.complaintPlaceholder: Describe the symptom, noise, or the service you need…
booking.odometerHint: This becomes the vehicle's latest reading after the service is completed.
booking.notePlaceholder: Anything else the mechanic should know?
booking.bookingRequestedBody: The workshop will confirm your slot and estimate. You can track everything from Bookings.
booking.loginRequiredBody: Your vehicle and service history live in your account.
booking.complaintMin: Describe the complaint in at least 10 characters.
booking.odometerLow: Odometer cannot be lower than the last record.
booking.error: We could not create this booking.
booking.capacityNote: Only confirmed and in-progress bookings hold a bay. Requested bookings are a request, not a lock.
booking.cancellationPolicy: Cancel free up to 2 hours before the slot. Later cancellations need a message to the workshop.
booking.leadTimeNote: Bookings open from 1 hour ahead up to 30 days ahead.

shop.title: BengkelShop
shop.subtitle: Parts from workshops across the city. Pickup or courier delivery.
shop.noProductsBody: Try a different category or clear the search.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.subtitle: Shop several workshops at once. Delivery is chosen per workshop at checkout.
cart.emptyBody: Find a part from a workshop near you.
cart.pickupNote: Choose pickup at the counter or courier delivery at checkout.
cart.shippingAtCheckout: Choose pickup, GoSend, or a commercial courier for each workshop at checkout.
cart.clearAllConfirm: Remove every item from all workshops?
cart.loginRequired: Sign in to see your cart

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.subtitle: Choose pickup or delivery for each workshop, then pay.
checkout.phoneHint: The workshop uses this number to reach you about your order.
checkout.vaHint: A virtual account number is generated for this order.
checkout.bankTransferHint: Transfer to the workshop account shown after checkout.
checkout.qrisHint: Scan the QR shown after checkout with any QRIS app.
checkout.terms: By placing these orders you agree to each workshop's fulfilment and no refunds in v1.
checkout.termsBody: Stock is reserved for 60 minutes while payment is pending.
checkout.error: We could not place this order.
checkout.perWorkshopHint: Every workshop becomes its own order, so you can pick a different courier for each one.
checkout.deliveryAddressHint: Used for every workshop you choose to deliver.
checkout.addressLineHint: Street, house number, RT/RW, and any notes for the courier.
checkout.separatePayments: Each workshop order is paid separately from your Orders page.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Parts and pickup codes in one place.
orders.emptyBody: Browse the parts shop and place your first pickup order.
orders.showPickupCode: Show this code at the counter.
orders.simulatePaymentHint: Marks the pending payment as paid (local fake provider only).
orders.cancelConfirm: Cancel this order? Reserved stock will be released.
orders.pickupInstructionsBody: Bring the pickup code and the phone number used at checkout. Staff will verify the code before handing over the parts.
orders.paymentPendingBody: Complete the payment before the window closes. Stock is reserved until then.
orders.paymentExpiredBody: The payment window closed and the reserved stock was released.
orders.preparingBody: The workshop has started picking your parts.
orders.readyBody: Your parts are waiting at the counter.
orders.shippedBody: Your order is with the courier. Confirm receipt once it arrives.
orders.deliveryInstructionsBody: The workshop packs your order first, then adds the courier and tracking number. Confirm receipt here once it arrives.
orders.trackingPending: Tracking is added after the workshop hands the parcel to the courier.
orders.completedBody: This order is complete. You can review the parts you bought.
orders.cancelledBody: This order was cancelled and stock was released.

bookings.title: Service bookings
bookings.subtitle: Requests, confirmed bays, invoices and service history.

bookings.confirmedBody: Your bay is confirmed. Arrive 10 minutes early with the vehicle.
bookings.startedBody: The mechanic has started work. Updates appear here.
bookings.completedBody: Work is complete. Review the invoice and pay online or cash at the counter.
bookings.paidBody: Payment is recorded. You can leave a review for this service.
bookings.awaitingApprovalBody: The invoice is above 150% of the estimate. Approve the extra work to finish the service.
bookings.declinedBody: The workshop declined this request. Try another slot or workshop.
bookings.cancelledBody: This booking was cancelled. No bay is held.
bookings.noShowBody: The workshop marked this booking as a no-show.

bookings.estimateNote: This is the workshop's estimate. The final invoice can change if extra work is needed.
bookings.reviewBody: Your review helps other customers choose a workshop.
bookings.cashNote: Choose cash and pay at the counter. The workshop records the payment.
